description: Set up or change the business's loyalty stamp card program: how many stamps earn the reward, the reward text and whether the card is live. Only provided fields change; the first call must include stamps_required and reward_text. The card's look is theme settings (the card_* settings in get_site's theme settings: stamp icon, layout, pattern, finish, radius, logo and colors) — change it with update_theme_settings; card_config here is the older shape of the same thing and is applied as theme settings. The page's copy is the loyalty page's loyalty-card section (update_section). Requires the Pro plan (402 plan_required otherwise — offer create_checkout_link).

card_config.description: Older shape of the card's look — colors{cardBg,cardFg,stampFilled,stampEmpty}, stampIcon, layout, pattern, finish, radius, showLogo, back{bg,fg}. Written as the site's card_* theme settings, replacing them all; null resets the card to the site's colors. Prefer update_theme_settings.

is_active.description: Whether diners can join and collect stamps

reward_text.description: What the guest gets, e.g. "A free coffee"

name: update_loyalty_card
title: Update loyalty card
